name: stm32f4
comment: An STM32F407: Cortex-M4F with a single-precision float unit, 1 MB of flash and 192 KB of RAM. The bare-metal build is a compiler and a linker script; ST's own HAL or CubeMX is not used, so nothing here depends on them.

flash.comment: 1 MB, the whole of the on-chip flash

ram.comment: 128 KB of SRAM1, where the stack and the data live

ccm.comment: 64 KB of core-coupled memory, reachable by the core only and not by DMA

flash.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f4x.cfg -c "program {binary} verify reset exit"
flash.comment: flashing reaches the chip through an ST-Link, which every F4 development board carries
